checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both closed hands stay on machine handles.
checks.feet: Left foot on step; right ankle cuff joined to a red resistance band fixed to the low rack. Torso and support leg fixed; band elongation and ankle contact checked.
checks.movement: Standing right knee curl against a red resistance band secured to the low front rack. Left foot on step, fixed hands and torso, knee 180 to 80 degrees; four seconds each direction. Band length increases while its thickness decreases.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
